name: LLM Digital Footprint & Cold-Pitch Governance
description: Deterministic pre-action gate suite ensuring external AI search presence, PR pitches, and marketing materials meet journalist-grade empirical rigor and cross-channel invariant congruence.

gates.description: Blocks outbound PR pitches, journalist cold outreach, and press releases that score below 75 on the Journalist Pitch Oracle (fluff intros, zero empirical data, commodity AI jargon).
gates.message: Action blocked: Outbound pitch detected with commodity fluff or ungrounded claims. Use the Journalist Cold-Pitch Oracle (llm-footprint-oracle --pitch) to ensure empirical data density and crisp hook clarity.

gates.description: Interdicts publishing changes that introduce contradictory entity definitions across documentation, schema.org markup, and product landing pages.
gates.message: Action blocked: Cross-channel entity drift detected. External AI search visibility requires 100% semantic congruence across all digital surfaces.
